input_contract.scenario: text label; takeoff, hover, flight, approach, landing, and grounded are canonical modes
input_contract.phase: normalized progress in [0, 1] within the supplied scenario
input_contract.altitude_error_m: goal altitude minus measured altitude, in m
input_contract.heading_error_rad: desired heading minus measured heading, wrapped by the runner; positive means desired heading is to the right
input_contract.vertical_speed_mps: measured vertical speed, in m/s; no body position is read here
input_contract.other_errors: optional finite precomputed errors accepted for future calibrations

population_inputs.name: dng02-left-flight-state
population_inputs.description: Left-side DNg02 external rate; kept disjoint from the right-side selector.
population_inputs.rationale: 35 Hz is an explicit hover-power trim anchor. The takeoff/landing levels are hand-built calibration hypotheses, not measured firing-rate claims. The 36 Hz/rad heading gain is a bounded turn hypothesis: at a 0.9 rad error it produces 67.4 Hz before the paired side reaches 2.6 Hz, remaining inside the 0-80 Hz external-rate bounds.

population_inputs.name: dng02-right-flight-state
population_inputs.description: Right-side DNg02 external rate; kept disjoint from the left-side selector.
population_inputs.rationale: 35 Hz is an explicit hover-power trim anchor. Positive heading error means a rightward desired heading; DNg02 contralaterality makes the left population stronger for the positive right-wing steering convention. The paired -36 Hz/rad term is a bounded external-rate hypothesis, not a measured firing-rate claim; at +/-0.9 rad both sides remain within [0,80] Hz.

population_inputs.name: dnp11-takeoff-state
population_inputs.description: Explicit takeoff descending-neuron input from the documented takeoff map.
population_inputs.rationale: DNp11 is named as a takeoff population in neuromuscular_map.json and MotorMap.java. This bounded rate is an external calibration hypothesis; no spike train is fabricated.

population_inputs.rationale: DNp02 is named as a takeoff population in neuromuscular_map.json and MotorMap.java. The absolute rate is a bounded calibration hypothesis, not a biological measurement.

population_inputs.name: dnp07-landing-state
population_inputs.description: Explicit landing descending-neuron input from the documented landing map.
population_inputs.rationale: DNp07 is named in neuromuscular_map.json as a landing population. Its state-gated rate is a bounded calibration hypothesis; the documented 92 Hz value is retained as a readout anchor, not copied as an input claim.

population_inputs.description: Explicit landing descending-neuron input from the documented landing map.
population_inputs.rationale: DNp10 is named in neuromuscular_map.json as a landing population. The absolute rate is an external calibration hypothesis, not a published in-vivo firing rate.

provenance.hover_anchor: 35 Hz per DNg02 cell is an explicit hover-power calibration anchor
provenance.population_map: config/neuromuscular_map.json; selectors resolve against the MaleCNS CSR tables
provenance.state_sign: positive heading_error_rad increases DNg02/L and decreases DNg02/R; DNg02 contralaterality yields the positive right-wing steering convention

turn_task.replay_evidence: The 1000-frame artifact contains only 0.2 s of turn: yaw=0.00758022 rad versus goal=0.08932072 rad at the endpoint. This tunes the external rate differential only; it does not claim body or motor response.

provenance.external_only: rates/currents are injected at the MaleCNS boundary; no spikes, body coordinates, or motor commands are emitted
